title: Why Do We Blink?
hook: Blink. Your eyes just washed themselves.
narration: Blink. Your eyes just washed themselves.
This 3D Short is only about this: Why Do We Blink.
Tears are a thin clean film.
Let me show you that in 3D.
Blinking spreads that film like a tiny wiper.
Watch this next bit closely. This is why it happens.
That is why eyes do not dry out.
So the idea is simple: cause, then effect.
Remember: Blink. Your eyes just washed themselves.
The pictures today are a new eye world. Not yesterday's film.
That is the whole idea, in one short 3D film.
Stay to the end. The last shot is the takeaway for why do we blink.
If a grown-up is with you, pause and tell them the cause in one sentence.
Tomorrow a brand new 3D film. Same curious science. Brand new pictures.
